name: Alaska Current
scope: Regional northward Alaska Current branch offshore British Columbia and southeast Alaska, using OSW latitude gates at 48 and 58.5 degrees N. Excludes the northern/northwestern Alaskan Stream, the distinct nearshore Alaska Coastal Current, individual fjords and offshore eddy excursions. Gate alternatives vary the regional reach; not the entire counterclockwise Gulf of Alaska gyre or an observed continuous shelf-edge jet.
layer: Regional upper-ocean flow geography; no common fixed depth or measured current core diagnosed.
time_convention: Undated regional sketch using the source's naming convention. The 1977 Kodiak observations support a distinction between current names, not this full route or a simultaneous 1977 northern branch path.
source_locator: Section 1.1, printed page 1 (PDF page index 4): Alaska Current northward off British Columbia/southeast Alaska; Alaskan Stream on northern/northwestern gyre arm. Section 2.1 gives Kodiak observations of the separate stream rather than a whole Alaska Current axis.
source_citation: Schumacher, Reed, Grigsby and Dreves (1979), Circulation and hydrography near Kodiak Island, September to November 1977, NOAA Technical Memorandum ERL PMEL-13.
source_license: Factual geography and naming only; no source prose, charts, figures, provider geometry or observational arrays packaged.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects offshore regional gates and every waypoint. The primary source supports northward branch identity and the stream distinction, not these coordinates, exact latitude limits or a diagnosed bathymetric contour. The route does not trace the distinct nearshore Alaska Coastal Current.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Shorter OSW southeast-Alaska regional gate convention; no source-published exact termination implied.
Broader offshore British Columbia/eastern Gulf convention; does not continue along northern/northwestern stream arm.

scenario_rule: Three regional reach/gate conventions crossed with three longitude shifts (-0.25/0/+0.25 degrees) and independent endpoint latitude shifts (-0.25/0/+0.25 degrees): 81 editorial scenarios. These do not represent an empirical axis-position distribution.
remaining_gates: Scientific review of regional gates and distinctions among Alaska Current, Alaskan Stream and Alaska Coastal Current.
Compare offshore sketch against reproducible upper-ocean circulation geometry and deep/shelf distinctions.
Canonical admission and publication review; no whole-gyre or nearshore current length inferred.

supporting_sources.citation: NOAA Tides and Currents Glossary, Alaska Current and Alaskan Stream entries.
supporting_sources.locator: Alaska Current regional Gulf of Alaska description; Alaskan Stream extension along southern Aleutian Islands.
supporting_sources.role: General identity context; primary-source convention distinguishes the northward branch from the stream.
